title: The Duck on the Deck
lines: Nick and Dad sit on the deck.
Nick has a sack of buns.
A duck tugs at the sack!
Nick picks it up and backs up.
The duck taps at his red sock.
Nick sits back and a bun falls off the sack.
The duck gets it. "What luck!" said Dad.
The duck naps on the deck.

questions.ask: What does the duck tap at after the sack?
questions.listenFor: Nick's red sock. This is stated in the story — if they guess, have them find the line with the word sock in it.

questions.ask: What happens when Nick sits back?
questions.listenFor: A bun falls off, and the duck gets it. Lines six and seven.

questions.ask: What did the duck want in this story? How did it get it?
questions.listenFor: A bun. It tugged at the sack, then tapped at Nick's sock. When Nick sat back, a bun fell off the sack. Lines three to seven.
